stories.title: Define External Link Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a structured schema for external verification links including site name, URL, label, and standardized guidance text explaining how users should interpret each source (e.g., what NPI Registry vs Healthgrades represents).

stories.title: Implement External Link Construction Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to construct external verification links using provider identifiers (e.g., NPI, state) including Healthgrades, NPI Registry, and state medical board URLs.

stories.title: Expose External Links via EvaluateCare Facade and UI Rendering
stories.description: Expose structured external links through the EvaluateCare facade and render them in the frontend with clear labels and inline guidance (tooltips or helper text) to help users understand source credibility and purpose.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for External Links
stories.description: Create unit tests for link construction and validation logic and integration tests to validate end-to-end delivery of external links including URL validation, fallback correction, and handling missing data (e.g., missing state board link).

stories.title: Integrate URL Validation for External Links
stories.description: Integrate url_guardian to validate and sanitize all external verification links (HEAD check, AI verification, fallback correction) before returning them to the frontend, ensuring links are safe, reachable, and corrected if stale.
